text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! Don't you think
I got super duper cute?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: During my break, I went on a full-course beauty tour with my big sister♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I got my hair cut, did a tail spa treatment,
and went to the nail salon and cosmetics shop, too♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, praise me, praise me~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Vivlos was able
to enjoy a fulfilling day off.
